question_set.question: Use find_extremes with top_n equal to 5, mode equal to both and use add_marginal_bars with show_top equal to True, show_right equal to True in order to know What patterns can be observed in drug-related incidents across Berlin districts over time? Analyze the spatial and temporal distribution to identify trends and hotspots.

answer.value: Drug-related incidents show clear spatial and temporal patterns across Berlin. Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg stands out dramatically with an average of 440.0 incidents, nearly 1.5 times higher than the second-ranked Mitte (300.5). These two districts form a clear drug activity hotspot in central Berlin. There is a consistent upward trend over time, with average incidents increasing from 77.9 in 2012 to 122.2 in 2019, representing a 57% increase. The top 5 district-year combinations are all from Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, peaking at 619.0 incidents in 2015. In contrast, Treptow-Kopenick maintains the lowest drug activity (21.6 average), followed by Lichtenberg (31.5) and Pankow (35.5), forming a low-activity cluster in the eastern suburbs. The heatmap reveals that drug activity is heavily concentrated in the central, entertainment-oriented districts, while residential and suburban areas maintain consistently low levels.
